subject: general
question: Data Protection Bill 2021 ensures which fundamental right?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Right to Privacy.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Data Protection Bill 2021** ensures the **fundamental right to privacy** for individuals in India.
 
• This right includes the right to control how **personal data** is **collected, processed, and shared** by entities such as government agencies and** private companies.**
 
• The bill also outlines penalties for **violations of this right**, including **fines and imprisonment.**
 
• The right to privacy is recognized as a **fundamental right **in the Indian Constitution under **Article 21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Right to Freedom of Speech** is also recognized as a **fundamental right** in the Indian Constitution.
 
• **Article 21-A** states that all children between the ages of six and fourteen have the fundamental** right to free and compulsory education.**
 
• A law known as the **Right to Information Act of 2005 (RTI)** was passed by the Indian Parliament "to provide for setting out the practical regime of **right to information **for citizens."
